title: Schema drift in the orders pipeline
note: Synthetic sample written by hand for the portfolio. Mock pipeline, made-up data. Not a recording of a real run.

payload.text: 2 columns changed: amount renamed to order_total, created_at changed from timestamp to string.
The upstream team changed the orders table. The revenue job still reads `amount`, so tonight's revenue report would be empty.
Severity P1: revenue reporting is affected. Paging the data-platform on-call engineer.
Map `order_total` back to `amount` in the ingest step, cast `created_at` to a timestamp, then re-run the revenue job.
